alerts.alertDescriptionText:
Effective Saturday, Aug. 22 the following service changes begin for Route 14: 
Better Bus Route improvements begin.

Weekday frequency will improve from every 20 minutes to every 15 minutes between 11 a.m. and 6:30 p.m.

Schedule will be adjusted to better reflect travel time.

Route 14E trips currently serving 38th St. Station will be discontinued. 14S trips via 42nd St. and 28th Ave. for Roosevelt High School will arrive at 8:15 a.m. and depart at 3:18 p.m.

Buses will travel on Richfield Pkwy. between 63rd St. and 66th St.

All non-school trips start/end at Cedar Point Commons at 66th St. & Richfield Parkway.

All trips will travel on W. Broadway through north Minneapolis and Robbinsdale.

Service on Noble Ave., 36th Ave., Douglas Dr., and Duluth St./Golden Valley Rd will be replaced by new local Route 48.
View a preview of the updated schedule by selecting "Schedule effective Aug. 22" at the link shown.
